authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat odd-faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 1-29 (odd side, Bilderdijkkade end), 1883-1885 plus the post-war block 7-17. Plain-brick fronts (1-5, 25-29), three wall-dormer fronts (19-23, face-local type), one 33.5 m brown-brick infill block (7-17) as 7 modules of kinker-1985-infill with a flat top. Shops read on zoom crops of the 2024-12-11 strip.
